bundle.text:
# This bundle's rows. `dsh.bundle.patch` points here, so the profile loader
# composes them over whatever the profile already had.
#
# One row. It used to be two: a `dsh-channel-wechat/startup` row claimed the app
# argument (`login`/`logout`/`status`) and published `wechatStartup` for this row
# to read. That split existed because only a row declaring `inject` is handed the
# launcher's command line - but `cmdlineArgs` is provided by every launcher before
# the tree mounts, so this row declares it directly and the profile shows one
# plugin instead of two.
- insert:
    - id: channel-wechat
      name: dsh-channel-wechat
      config:
        # The working directory every session this channel creates records.
        #
        # Required, and deliberately not defaulted in code: a session's `cwd` is
        # immutable once written, so a silent default would be recorded into
        # sessions that can never be moved. The system prompt's `{{cwd}}` reads
        # it, and a prompt variable with no value fails the turn before the
        # provider is called - a user-visible "message sent, no reply".
        #
        # `process.cwd()` is the launcher's own directory, which is what the
        # shipped headless runner resolves by default. Editable from the plugin's
        # own page in the GUI; a value saved there replaces this expression with
        # a literal path, and clearing the field restores the expression.
        cwd: !!js process.cwd()
        # Where an interaction card can be answered.
        #
        # `wechat` keeps one card in one place: this channel claims the request
        # and the GUI is never offered it. `both` also offers the GUI card and the
        # first answer wins, at the cost of a GUI card that lingers until the turn
        # ends when WeChat answered first - the seam has no way to withdraw it.
        #
        # Written out although it equals the default, so the choice is visible in
        # the profile rather than buried in the schema.
        cards: wechat

把微信（腾讯 iLink / ClawBot）接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的通道插件。它以一个 npm 包同时提供 Harness bundle 和 GUI 浏览器端，运行在 Harness 进程内。
**这个插件的重点不是功能清单的长度，而是消息不丢。** 一轮结束时的回答才发出（旁白和工具参数不会被当成回答），超长正文按段落切开而不是整条被服务端拒绝，`ret: -2` 限流按 2s→4s→8s→16s 退避而不是重试三次后静默丢弃。这三条都有测试钉住，改坏时 CI 会失败。
| 微信里对话 | 微信里审批 | 插件页 | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | 直接在聊天里问、让它干活，回复回到微信 | 审批卡和提问卡转发到微信，回复编号即可 | 扫码登录、工作目录、卡片投递位置、权限、模型 |

- 微信文本、图片、文件等消息与 DSH 双向收发。
- 微信消息进入 DSH 会话，回复从 `session/event` 回到微信。
- 微信内置命令（`/help`、`/skills`、`/cwd`、`/models`、`/model`、`/status`、`/stop`、`/new`）、审批卡和提问卡。
- 只有扫码登录的那个微信号能驱动这个机器人；其他人发来的消息不建会话、不执行命令、也不回复。
- `/cwd <绝对路径>` 在微信里切换工作目录：结束当前会话，在新目录开始新对话，切换跨重启保留。
- 审批卡可直接把当前会话切到完全权限；生成期间微信显示「对方正在输入」。
- 提问卡的答案可以是选项编号，也可以是你自己写的话；卡片上的 `0` 表示「换到对话里说」，整张卡随即作废。
- 多张卡片同时出现时一次只显示一张（标题带「第 N/M 张」），答完当前这张再发下一张；`/stop` 会一次性作废该会话所有待确认的卡片。
- GUI 插件页扫码登录、退出登录、配置工作目录、卡片投递方式、模型和权限。
- 长轮询与会话处理解耦；诊断写入终端和插件日志。
群聊、运行期多账号、主动推送和独立权限系统不在当前范围内。

| 组件 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24.0.0` |
| pnpm | 11（仓库声明 `pnpm@11.7.0`） |
| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.2.0-rc.1` |

安装门槛来自 `package.json` 的 `engines`；已验证版本和未验证范围见 [兼容性说明](./docs/compatibility.md)。

1. 确认 profile 已有一个你希望用于微信会话的工作目录。
2. 安装插件并重启 DSH：

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-channel-wechat
   ```

3. 打开 GUI 的 **Plugins → dsh-channel-wechat**，点击登录微信，使用手机扫码；需要验证码时在页面输入。
4. 从微信向 bot 发一条消息，确认 DSH 回复返回微信。

安装后必须完全退出并重启 DSH，宿主才能发现浏览器端配置页。刚发布版本若被 pnpm 的观察期跳过，可使用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-channel-wechat@latest --config.minimumReleaseAge=0
```

GUI 页面可编辑全部配置。也可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中写：

```yaml
- id: channel-wechat
  config:
    cwd: /你的/工作目录
    cards: wechat

`cwd` 必须是绝对路径；它在会话创建时写入且不可变，修改只影响之后的新会话。完整字段、默认值和权限边界见 [配置参考](./docs/configuration.md)。

`allow` 决定谁能用这个机器人。留空时只放行扫码登录的那个账号，这是零配置的默认值；要授权别人，在插件页的「允许使用的人」里一行填一个微信 id。填入名单后**以名单为准**，登录者不再自动包含——被拒的消息不会回复，只在插件日志里留一行带对方 id 的记录，那个 id 就是填进名单的值。

没有 web app 的 profile 可以使用终端登录：

```bash
dsh <profile> login
dsh <profile> status
dsh <profile> logout
```
web/desktop profile 的启动器会先拒绝 `login` 位置参数，请改用 GUI 登录。

| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 会话记录 | `~/.dsh/sessions/<cwd 转义>/channel-wechat-<peerId>[~g<N>]/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` |
| 插件状态 | `~/.dsh/channel-wechat/` |
| 诊断日志 | `~/.dsh/channel-wechat/log/channel-wechat-YYYY-MM-DD.log`，保留 7 天 |
| 登录凭证 | `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` |

聊天记录由 DSH 持久化，`/new` 只创建新的会话代次，不删除旧记录。排障时不要分享 token、Cookie 或凭证文件内容。

- **插件页没有配置区**：完全退出并重新打开 DSH，见 [故障排查](./docs/troubleshooting.md)。
- **登录命令报参数错误**：web/desktop 只支持 GUI 登录。
- **消息没有回复**：先查插件日志、账号状态和 `cwd` 是否为绝对路径。
- **引用或媒体降级为文本**：部分引用字段和服务端 uint64 消息 id 是已记录限制，详见故障排查。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-channel-wechat)
[](https://github.com/wangx-wx/dsh-channel-wechat/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](./LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A channel plugin that connects WeChat (Tencent iLink / ClawBot) to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). One npm package provides both the Harness bundle and the GUI browser half; it runs inside the Harness process.

**What sets this apart from the other WeChat channels is not more features — it is that messages do not go missing.** Only the turn's final answer is sent, so narration and tool arguments are never posted as replies; an over-long answer is split on paragraph boundaries instead of being rejected whole; a `ret: -2` rate limit backs off 2s→4s→8s→16s instead of being dropped silently after three one-second retries. Tests pin all three, so CI fails when a change breaks them.

| In WeChat | Approval card | Plugin page | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Ask and assign work in the chat; replies come back to WeChat | Approval and question cards are relayed to WeChat; reply with a number | QR login, working directory, card placement, permission, model |

- Two-way text, image, and file messaging.
- Inbound WeChat messages become DSH turns; durable `session/event` messages are sent back to WeChat.
- Commands in WeChat (`/help`, `/skills`, `/cwd`, `/models`, `/model`, `/status`, `/stop`, `/new`), approval cards, and question cards.
- Only the WeChat account that scanned the login can drive the bot; messages from anyone else create no session, run no command, and get no reply.
- `/cwd <absolute-path>` switches the working directory from WeChat: the current conversation ends and a new one starts in that directory, and the choice survives a restart.
- An approval card can switch the current conversation to full access; WeChat shows "typing" while a turn runs.
- A question card accepts either an option number or your own words; `0` on the card means "talk it over instead" and closes the card.
- When several cards arrive at once, only one is shown at a time, headed "N of M", and the next follows once you answer; `/stop` withdraws every card waiting in that conversation.
- QR login, sign-out, working directory, card delivery, model, and permission settings on the GUI plugin page.
- Long polling decoupled from turn processing, with terminal
Group chats, multiple accounts at runtime, unsolicited push, and a separate permission system are out of scope.

| Component | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` |
| pnpm | 11 (`package.json` declares `pnpm@11.7.0`) |
| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.2.0-rc.1` |

The install floor comes from `package.json` `engines`; see [compatibility](./docs/compatibility.md) for verified and unverified versions.

1. Make sure the profile has a working directory you want to use for WeChat sessions.
2. Install the plugin and restart DSH:

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-channel-wechat
   ```

3. Open **Plugins → dsh-channel-wechat** in the GUI, click **Sign in to WeChat**, and scan the QR code. Enter a verify code on the page if requested.
4. Send a message to the bot from WeChat and confirm that the DSH reply arrives there.

A full DSH restart is required after installation so the host can discover the browser half. If pnpm's observation window skips a just-published release, use:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-channel-wechat@latest --config.minimumReleaseAge=0
```

The GUI page edits all fields. The same values can be written in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: channel-wechat
  config:
    cwd: /your/workspace
    cards: wechat

`cwd` must be absolute. It is recorded when a session is created and cannot be changed for that session; edits affect sessions created afterwards. See [configuration reference](./docs/configuration.md) for fields, defaults, and permission boundaries.

`allow` decides who may use the bot. Empty admits only the account that scanned the login, which is the zero-configuration default; to admit others, put one WeChat id per line in "Who may use this bot" on the plugin page. A non-empty list is authoritative — the logged-in account is no longer included automatically. A refused message gets no reply; the plugin log keeps one line with the sender's id, which is the value to paste into the list.

Profiles without a web app can use the terminal:

```bash
dsh <profile> login
dsh <profile> status
dsh <profile> logout
```

On web/desktop profiles the launcher rejects the `login` positional argument before this plugin runs; use the GUI instead.

| What | Location |
|---|---|
| Session transcript | `~/.dsh/sessions/<escaped cwd>/channel-wechat-<peerId>[~g<N>]/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` |
| Plugin state | `~/.dsh/channel-wechat/` |
| Diagnostic log | `~/.dsh/channel-wechat/log/channel-wechat-YYYY-MM-DD.log`, kept 7 days |
| Login credential | `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` |
DSH persists the transcript. `/new` creates a new conversation generation and does not delete older records. Never share tokens, cookies, or credential files when reporting an issue.

- **No configuration section**: fully quit and reopen DSH; see [troubleshooting](./docs/troubleshooting.md).
- **Login argument rejected**: web/desktop profiles support GUI login only.
- **No reply**: check the plugin log, account status, and that `cwd` is absolute.
- **Media or quote degraded to text**: some quote fields and the server's uint64 message id are known limitations; see troubleshooting.

Integration tests use a temporary isolated `DSH_HOME` and look for a local DeepSeek Harness checkout. Set `DSH_CHECKOUT=/path/to/deepseek-harness` when needed. See [development and verification](./docs/development.md).
